nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf storing token balances of the UniswapExchange token.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] storing spending approvals.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged access control anchor.
Address tradeAddress whitelisted inside ensure() via setTradeAddress().
Mapping(address=>bool) canSale marking addresses whitelisted by the owner-only _mints() function.
Mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum counting how many times an address has sold.
uint256 _saleNum global sale count limit configured by init().
uint256 _minSale minimum sale amount configured by init().
uint256 _maxSale maximum sale amount configured by init().
Public uint totalSupply of the token, set in the constructor.
Constant uint public decimals = 18 used in supply and limit scaling.
Public string name of the token, set in the constructor.
Public string symbol of the token, set in the constructor.
External payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
External payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) performing allowance checks, ensure() whitelist gate and raw balance mutations.
External payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI routers, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise enforcing condition().
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall, a full-contract takeover backdoor.
Semi-privileged mint/whitelist function that can arbitrarily overwrite balanceOf[spender] and set canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer using unchecked arithmetic to distribute tokens to a list of recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and a max allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address driving transfers, approvals, whitelist checks and privilege checks.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing attacker/owner-supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
Raw unchecked arithmetic balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value inside transferFrom.
Raw unchecked arithmetic _value * _tos.length and balanceOf updates inside batchSend.
Parameter _to of transfer(): recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(): amount to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(): source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(): recipient address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(): amount used for allowance and raw balance math.
Parameter _from of ensure(): address being whitelisted.
Parameter _to of ensure(): recipient compared against owner.
Parameter _value of ensure(): amount forwarded to condition().
Parameter _from of condition(): address whose _onSaleNum is checked.
Parameter _value of condition(): amount compared against _minSale/_maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate(): delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(): delegatecall calldata.
Parameter spender of _mints(): account whose balance is overwritten.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(): raw balance value assigned to spender.
Parameter saleNum of init(): sets _saleNum.
Parameter token of init(): sets _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(): sets _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(): recipient array controlling loop length.
Parameter _value of batchSend(): per-recipient amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(): new whitelisted trade address.
Parameter _name of the constructor.
Parameter _symbol of the constructor.
Parameter _supply of the constructor: unscaled supply.
Parameter _spender of approve().
Parameter _value of approve(): approved amount.
Local uint total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection in batchSend.
Local loop counter i in batchSend.
Local _to = _tos[i] recipient inside the batchSend loop.
Local _UNI computed via pairFor() and used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.

edges.reason: transferFrom reads msg.sender for the allowance spender check and the transfer authorisation.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
_mints is gated by msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, anchoring all privileged functions.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a whitelist gate.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor() to derive the expected Uniswap pair address.
delegate executes the unsafe delegatecall with caller-supplied target and data.
transferFrom performs unchecked -= and += balance mutations on the amount.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
ensure whitelists the owner-controlled tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists any address flagged in canSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether counting applies.
condition reads _minSale lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale upper bound.
_mints arbitrarily overwrites balanceOf[spender] without any accounting of totalSupply.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting permanent transfer whitelisting.
init sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1) allowance.
transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into transferFrom.
transferFrom source address parameter used for balance and allowance lookups.
transferFrom recipient address parameter used for balance credit.
transferFrom amount feeds directly into the unchecked balance subtraction/addition.
ensure uses _from for the whitelist comparisons.
ensure uses _to for the owner comparison.
ensure forwards _value to condition().
condition indexes _onSaleNum by _from.
condition compares _value to _minSale and _maxSale.
delegatecall target a is supplied by the caller (owner).
delegatecall payload b is supplied by the caller (owner).
_mints writes balanceOf and canSale for the spender parameter.
_mints uses addedValue directly as the new balance.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
init scales token into _minSale.
init scales maxToken into _maxSale.
batchSend iterates the caller-supplied _tos array.
batchSend _value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection.
setTradeAddress writes addr into the tradeAddress whitelist.
Constructor stores _name into name.
Constructor stores _symbol into symbol.
Constructor scales _supply into totalSupply.
approve writes allowance for the _spender parameter.
approve stores the _value parameter as the approved amount.
Local total is subtracted from the caller balance inside the unchecked batchSend math.
Loop index i drives the unchecked per-recipient balance credits.
Local _to is credited with _value inside the batchSend loop.
Local _UNI computed by pairFor is compared against _from in the ensure whitelist.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to exists only to forward into the transfer flow.
Parameter _value exists only to forward into the transfer flow.
Parameter _from is the source address of the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _to is the recipient address of the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _value is consumed by the unchecked balance arithmetic node.
Parameter _from is only used inside the ensure gate.
Parameter _to is only used inside the ensure gate.
Parameter _value is only forwarded by ensure to condition.
Parameter _from is only used to index _onSaleNum in condition.
Parameter _value is only compared to the sale bounds in condition.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the calldata payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter spender is the account mutated by _mints.
Parameter addedValue is the raw balance value assigned by _mints.
Parameter saleNum is stored by init into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled and stored by init into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled and stored by init into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos is the recipient list iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is multiplied unchecked by the batch arithmetic node.
Parameter addr is stored by setTradeAddress into tradeAddress.
Parameter _name is only stored by the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is only stored by the constructor.
Parameter _supply is only scaled into totalSupply by the constructor.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the approved amount written by approve.
Local total exists only for the unchecked arithmetic in batchSend.
Local loop counter i belongs to the batchSend iteration.
Local _to is the per-iteration recipient inside batchSend.
Local _UNI is computed only for the whitelist comparison in ensure.
